about.subtitle: Full Stack developer with an eye for detail.
about.aboutMeText: In 2021 I moved to Italy and still love it. I live with my wife, two cats and a dog in a small village in northern Tuscany — good food, excellent coffee, and stable Wi‑Fi. When I’m not coding I play tennis, read Marvel comics, or work in the garden.
